whenToUse: Tool buttons that turn on and off, such as text formatting or view options.
Several can be on at once.
State is shown with icons inside a toolbar.
whenNotToUse: An on/off that saves a setting (use a switch).
Only one of several can be chosen (use a segmented control).
An action that runs immediately (use a button).
accessibility: Announce the pressed state with aria-pressed, and don't change the name ("Bold") with the state.
Group related buttons with role="toolbar" and a name.
The pressed state is clearly visible through background contrast.
Even single-letter buttons convey their meaning with aria-label.
